project_context.client: Studio Max Tattoo & Piercing (Sérgio Pereira, Sinop-MT)
project_context.goal: Repaginada visual completa para nível Awwwards. Estética de estúdio de tatuagem autoral misturando editorial contemporâneo, arte urbana e sofisticação.

hierarchy_rules.ghost_watermark: Anton, text-[15vw] to text-[25vw], text-transparent, stroke-1 stroke-[#888680]/10, uppercase, leading-none, absolute, select-none, z-0
hierarchy_rules.hero_title: Anton, text-6xl md:text-[8vw], uppercase, tracking-tighter, leading-[0.85]
hierarchy_rules.editorial_quotes: Instrument Serif, italic, text-4xl md:text-6xl, text-[#F1EEE8], tracking-tight
hierarchy_rules.technical_labels: Space Mono, uppercase, text-xs md:text-sm, tracking-[0.2em], text-[#F1EEE8]

visual_enhancers.bw_to_color: Images default to grayscale (filter: grayscale(100%)) with a 500ms ease-out transition to full color on hover.
visual_enhancers.offset_frames: Images placed in a container with an absolute border (border border-[#888680]/30) offset by -translate-x-3 -translate-y-3 or rotate-2. Adds analog/urban feel.
visual_enhancers.tilted_marquee: Marquee container rotated by -rotate-3, scaled to 110%, background #FF5A1F, text #080808. Creates aggressive, disruptive visual flow.
visual_enhancers.cursor_follower: Custom inverted or difference cursor using framer-motion (mix-blend-difference, bg-white, rounded-full, 16x16 or 32x32 on hover).
visual_enhancers.noise_overlay: Global fixed SVG noise/grain overlay (opacity-20, pointer-events-none, mix-blend-overlay) to remove digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.vertical_text: Use writing-mode: vertical-rl; transform: rotate(180deg); for section labels in Space Mono to frame content asymmetrically.

layouts.grid_system: Bento/Asymmetrical. Avoid perfect symmetry. Use 12-column grid but span items unpredictably (e.g., col-span-5 and col-span-6 with gap-8).
layouts.spacing: Hyper-generous. Use py-24 md:py-40 for section gaps. Let the typography breathe.
layouts.mobile_first: Start single column (px-4). Scale up typography aggressively only on md and lg breakpoints.

motion_and_interactions.scroll: Lenis already installed. Ensure momentum feels heavy and premium.
motion_and_interactions.reveal: Use Framer Motion. Elements reveal via masked Y-axis translations (y: 100% to 0) with clip-path or overflow-hidden wrappers. ONLY animate transform and opacity.
motion_and_interactions.cursor_image_preview: In the Styles section, map image absolute coordinates to mouse position using framer-motion useMotionValue and useSpring.
motion_and_interactions.reduced_motion: Wrap animations in useReducedMotion hook from framer-motion to disable complex parallax/reveals for accessibility.

sections_blueprint.name: Hero Cinematográfico
sections_blueprint.implementation: min-h-[90vh], bg-[#080808]. Ghost text 'MAX TATTOO' in background. Foreground: Masked reveal of main title. Parallax background image (B&W). Offset frame layout for the main featured photo.

sections_blueprint.name: Tilted Brand Marquee
sections_blueprint.implementation: Cross-screen ribbon. bg-[#FF5A1F], text-[#080808]. text-4xl Anton uppercase. -rotate-2 transform. scale-105 to hide edges. Smooth horizontal translate via framer-motion or CSS.

sections_blueprint.implementation: List of massive Anton items (OLD SCHOOL, BLACKWORK, ORIENTAL, MINIMALISTA, COVER-UP, PIERCING) acting as a menu. border-b border-white/10. On hover: Text turns #FF5A1F, and a preview image appears following the cursor (fixed, pointer-events-none, z-50).

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: DO NOT use standard HTML input/select elements, style everything via Tailwind or Shadcn equivalents.
ALL interactive elements (buttons, links, image thumbnails, modal triggers) MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='booking-modal-trigger'`).
Avoid standard Vercel/SaaS aesthetics completely. No rounded soft shadows. Use sharp 0px or slight 2px border radius, aggressive typographic scaling, and high contrast.
Ensure focus states are visible for accessibility (focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#FF5A1F]).
Do not alter any existing data, copy, phone numbers, or paths to local images (/img/g1.jpg, etc).
Write components in .js or .jsx (not TypeScript), utilizing Tailwind CSS classes directly.
